regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative tape with only 2 of 22 themes eligible (Coal, Banks) and Coal leading Banks by a negligible margin (score 1.137 vs 1.11). The absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and its Hurst tag says 'mean-revert', so the detector's only validated edge is absent here — this read defaults to low conviction and should be treated as experimental. Crowding flags on Banks and several healthcare names are sizing cautions only, not fades.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's leadership actually decays per its mean-revert tag: if Coal (515220.SS) loses its rank-1 spot to Banks or any currently ineligible theme within 21 trading days while both trade, that retires the one-narrative read. This is a structure watch, not a directional call.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the nominal leader but the trend-gate leg is not validated on this market and Coal's own Hurst tag is 'mean-revert', so leadership persistence is not supported by the detector. Durability_bar is 0.48 — middling — and r10 is slightly negative, suggesting the recent 10-period move has already stalled. The gate_helps=false condition means the absolute-trend discipline did not even trim drawdowns here, so chasing the leader on rank alone is exactly what the guardrails prohibit. Directionally neutral-to-cautious is the honest read.
evidence: coal rank=1 with score 1.137 but hurst_tag='mean-revert'
theses.dissent: Coal is the only theme actually logged as the headline with one_narrative=true, and if the CSI 300 embarks on a broad cyclical up-leg, Coal's current leadership could persist simply because it is the incumbent focus — mean-revert tags have failed before.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS closes up more than 8% from the 2026-10-21 level while still holding rank 1 by the check-by date, breaking the mean-revert read.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and show the strongest durability_bar (0.8) and breadth (0.778) on the board, but they are explicitly crowded (crowding_z=1.77, crowded=true). The guardrails forbid fading on crowding, but crowding is a size-down caution — and with direction uncertain and no validated gate edge here, the prudent lean is to not chase a crowded challenger at a 0.027 score margin. There is no momentum alpha to harvest; only drawdown discipline, which is unavailable on this tape.
evidence: gate_helps=false — trend discipline failed to cut drawdown on this market
theses.dissent: Banks are the one theme with a genuine trend tag (hurst_tag='trend') and high breadth of 0.778 — if a value/financial rotation takes hold in A-shares and the crowding unwinds via new inflows rather than a top, Banks could be the cleanest expression of that handoff.

falsifier.text: Bank ETF 512800.SS outperforms Coal ETF 515220.SS by more than 5 percentage points over the next 21 trading days, showing a confirmed handoff despite the crowding flag.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
